c002.coordinator_notes: Only one native prediction was given (a multi-controlled X); it is standard background and not used, since the sketch uses a Clifford construction. Correction: the sketch's claim that distinct t give disjoint target supports is false in general, since Ax xor t can coincide with Ax' xor t' when t xor t' is in col(A); eq_2 states this caveat, so the 2^n count is not guaranteed as written. Also, for n=m+1 with A=[1...1] the basis is only complete if the labels are chosen appropriately. This does not reproduce the paper's controlled-unitary method. I have not read the paper.
